# Standalone sandbox, part 1: image, engine copy, config and the `sandbox` commands ## What to build The engine is getting its own Docker sandbox, which works without graph-manager. This task builds the parts that do not start a run: 1. **`src/sandbox/docker.ts`**: a thin wrapper around the `docker` **CLI**, run through execa (not the socket API). It has `dockerAvailable()`, `imageExists(tag)`, `build(dockerfile, tag, { noCache, onLine })` (`docker build -t [--no-cache --pull] -` with the Dockerfile on stdin, no build context, output lines streamed), `imagePath(image)` (reads the image's `PATH` from `docker image inspect --format '{{json .Config.Env}}'`), `create(args)`, `cp(src, ctr, dest, { archive })`, `start`, `inspect(name)` (state, or undefined when missing), `port(name, "7600/tcp")`, `logs(name)` and `rm(name, { force })`. - The binary is `findOnPath("docker", cwd)`, from `src/providers/index.ts`. - Every function takes an injectable `exec` for unit tests. - Errors carry the command's stderr. 2. **`src/sandbox/image.ts`**: generates the Dockerfile and its tag. - The template file is `packages/graph-execution/sandbox/Dockerfile.template`, at the package root next to `skills/`. Add `"sandbox"` to `files` in `package.json`. Read it from code with `new URL("../../sandbox/Dockerfile.template", import.meta.url)`; that path works from both `src/sandbox/` and `dist/sandbox/`. - The template: ```dockerfile FROM {{base}} RUN node --version && npm --version && git --version RUN npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund {{packages}} RUN mkdir -p /home/sandbox && chmod 1777 /home/sandbox {{lines}} ``` - `{{packages}}` is the `npmPackage` of each provider asked for, from the catalog (`providerInfo(id)` in `src/providers/catalog.ts`), plus `bun` when `omp` is among them, deduplicated and in catalog order. `fake` adds no package. **With no provider given, every catalog package is installed, plus `bun`.** - `{{lines}}` is the config's `sandbox.dockerfile` lines, then the run's `--sandbox-line` lines. They are kept verbatim except that `\r` and trailing blank lines are dropped. - The tag is `graph-execution-sandbox:`. - A line whose first word is `FROM` (case-insensitive) is rejected with `FROM is not allowed in sandbox Dockerfile lines; use COPY --from=`. - `resolveImage(settings, providers)` returns `{ kind: "ready", image }` for a ready-made image, else `{ kind: "build", dockerfile, tag }`. 3. **`src/sandbox/engine.ts`**: copies the running engine once per version into `/sandbox-engine/-/`. `cacheDir` is `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/graph-execution`, else `~/.cache/graph-execution`, overridable with `GRAPH_EXECUTION_CACHE_DIR` for tests. It copies `package.json`, `dist`, `skills`, `sandbox`, `README.md` and the production dependency closure, flat in `node_modules`. Port this from graph-manager's `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-tools.ts`: `engineDirOf` (L32-40), `resolvePackage` (L43-52), `copyTree` (L60-66), `depsOf` (L68-73), `copyDependencies` (L79-105), `copyEngine` (L108-116), and the atomic `.next-` + rename pattern of `fillTools` (L128-160), which uses `renameReplacing` from `src/fs/rename.ts`. The engine dir is `fileURLToPath(new URL("../..", import.meta.url))` from `dist/sandbox/engine.js`. `ensureEngineCopy()` returns the folder path and reuses it when it is complete (a `VERSION` file written last). 4. **Config `sandbox` section** in `src/config/config.ts` `configSchema`, an optional `z.strictObject`: ```ts sandbox: z.strictObject({ image: z.string().regex(IMAGE).optional(), // ready-made image, skips the build base: z.string().regex(IMAGE).default("node:24.22.1-bookworm"), dockerfile: z.array(z.string()).default([]), // refine: no FROM line cpus: z.number().positive().default(2), memoryMb: z.number().int().min(256).default(4096), pids: z.number().int().min(64).default(2048), env: z.array(z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/)).default([]), // extra env var names passed in }).optional() ``` `IMAGE = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._\-/:@]{0,254}$/i`, the same as graph-manager's sandbox-image.ts L116. `image` together with a non-empty `dockerfile` is valid; the lines are just unused, and `sandbox config` warns. 5. **`resolveSandboxSettings(config, flags)`** in `src/sandbox/settings.ts` merges the run flags over the config: `--sandbox-image`, `--sandbox-base`, `--sandbox-line` (repeatable, appended), `--no-sandbox-config-lines`, `--sandbox-cpus`, `--sandbox-memory`, `--sandbox-pids`. Errors (a `UsageError`, exit 2): - `--sandbox-image` with `--sandbox-base` or `--sandbox-line`: `--sandbox-image is a ready-made image; it cannot be combined with --sandbox-base or --sandbox-line` - any image flag without `--sandbox`: `--sandbox-image needs --sandbox`, naming the first such flag given - a FROM line: the FROM message above The result is `SandboxSettings { image?: string; base: string; lines: string[]; cpus: number; memoryMb: number; pids: number; env: string[] }`. 6. **CLI commands** (`src/cli.ts`), mirroring the nested `install skills` group (~L312-334): - `graph-execution sandbox build [--provider

...] [--no-cache] [--image ] [--base ] [--line ...]` builds, or reuses an existing tag unless `--no-cache`. It prints the build output, then `Sandbox image: `. For a ready-made `--image`, it only checks that the image exists locally (`docker image inspect`) or pulls it (`docker pull`), then prints it. No docker → exit 2 with `--sandbox needs Docker: the docker command was not found or cannot reach a daemon`. - `graph-execution sandbox dockerfile [--provider

...] [--base ] [--line ...]` prints the Dockerfile, then `# tag: `. **It never runs docker.** - `graph-execution sandbox config [--image | --base ] [--line ]... [--clear-lines] [--cpus n] [--memory MB] [--pids n] [--unset-image]` edits the `sandbox` section of `graph-execution.config.json` at the repo root (the git top level): - It reads the raw JSON, creating `{}` when the file is missing, and merges into `.sandbox`. `--line` appends; `--clear-lines` empties first. - It validates the whole object with `configSchema`. On failure it exits 2 **without writing**, printing the config error. - It writes `JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2) + "\n"` and prints the resulting `sandbox` section. - With no option, it prints the current section merged with the defaults and writes nothing. - `--image` with `--base` exits 2. - Note in the output that a running run's `--resume` refuses a changed config file. That is an existing rule (`hashes.config`). - **GOTCHA**: the root program also declares `--provider` (and `--run`), so `sandbox build --provider x` may be consumed by the root. Mirror how `suite` handles it (~L367-381: `opts.provider ?? root.provider`). Because `--provider` here is repeatable, declare it on the subcommand with the `collect` helper (L68) and also accept the root's single value. - The `preSubcommand` hook (~L308-311) refuses root `--web` / `--web-serve` for every subcommand except `suite`; `sandbox` must be refused the same way. 7. **README**: a new "Sandbox (Docker)" section after "Safety" (~L575), covering the commands, the config section with every key, the precedence (run flags, then config, then default), the base image requirements (glibc, `node` >= 20, npm, git) and that the image installs only the CLIs the run needs. The run-level `--sandbox` usage is documented by the other sandbox task; just add a placeholder sentence: "Start a run in the sandbox with `--sandbox`." ## Context: files to read before implementing - `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts`: - the `install skills` group (~L312-334) - `suite` (~L357-415, its provider handling) - `collect` (L68) - `parseProvider` (L107-112) - `preSubcommand` (~L308-311) - `main` (L428-443): errors print `error: ` and exit through `exitCodeFor`; `UsageError` gives 2 - `packages/graph-execution/src/launch/preflight.ts` L28 `UsageError`. - `packages/graph-execution/src/config/config.ts`: `configSchema` (L8-42, nested strictObject style like `loopDetection` L34-36), `ConfigError`, and `loadConfig` (L99-123; its message format is `invalid config :\n sandbox.dockerfile.0: `). No code writes the config file today. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-tools.ts` (the code to port) and `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-image.ts` L116 (IMAGE), L217 (`clean`), L220-237 (Dockerfile join and tag hashing), L239-240 (FROM check). - `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/catalog.ts` (`providerInfo`, `PROVIDER_CATALOG`). - `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/index.ts` `findOnPath`. - `packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__/fake-bin.ts` `writeFakeBin(file, script)`. CLI tests (`src/cli.test.ts` L12-20) run the **built** `dist/cli.js` with `execa("node", [cli, ...args], { cwd, env, reject: false })`. `vitest.global-setup.ts` builds first. `onlyNodeAndGit(repo)` (cli.test.ts L43-50) makes a PATH with no docker. - `packages/graph-execution/package.json`: `files` and `postbuild` (no copy is needed for the template, because it is read from the package root). ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/sandbox/Dockerfile.template` ### CREATE `src/sandbox/docker.ts`, `image.ts`, `engine.ts`, `settings.ts` with unit tests - `docker.test.ts`: with an injected exec, check that argv is built right for each call and errors are wrapped. - `image.test.ts`: - providers `["claude"]` → a Dockerfile containing `npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund @anthropic-ai/claude-code` - `["omp"]` → includes `bun` - none → all seven + bun - a stable tag - a FROM line is rejected - the base replaced - config lines then flag lines - `engine.test.ts`: copy into a temp cache dir; the folder has `dist/cli.js`, `node_modules/zod/package.json` and `sandbox/Dockerfile.template`; a second call reuses it (same path, no rewrite). - `settings.test.ts`: precedence and the three errors. ### UPDATE `src/config/config.ts` (+ config.test.ts) ### UPDATE `src/cli.ts`: the `sandbox` command group (+ cli.test.ts) - **TEST**: - `sandbox dockerfile --provider pi` prints `@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent` and `# tag: graph-execution-sandbox:`, and works with no docker on the PATH. - `sandbox config --base node:22-bookworm --line 'RUN echo hi'` in a temp repo writes `{"sandbox":{"base":"node:22-bookworm","dockerfile":["RUN echo hi"]}}` and keeps other keys (`validate`). - `--line 'FROM x'` exits 2 and leaves the file unchanged. - `sandbox build` with `onlyNodeAndGit` exits 2 `--sandbox needs Docker`. - `sandbox build --provider claude` with a fake `docker` (it records argv and stdin to a file and answers `image inspect` with exit 1, i.e. missing) runs `docker build -t graph-execution-sandbox:<12hex> -` with the Dockerfile on stdin. ### UPDATE `package.json` (`files`), `README.md` ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `graph-execution sandbox dockerfile --provider claude` prints a Dockerfile starting `FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm` that installs `@anthropic-ai/claude-code`, plus its tag, with no docker needed. - [ ] `graph-execution sandbox config …` edits only the `sandbox` section, validates, and refuses FROM lines without writing. - [ ] `graph-execution sandbox build` builds through `docker build -t -` and reuses an existing tag. - [ ] The engine copy contains everything needed to run `node /dist/cli.js --version` (add a test that runs it). - [ ] `npm pack --dry-run -w graph-execution` lists `sandbox/Dockerfile.template`. - [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass. ## Validation commands ```bash npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-execution -- src/sandbox src/config src/cli.test.ts npm pack --dry-run -w graph-execution | grep Dockerfile.template ```
